title_zh: B-312 流感A病毒通用基因型鉴定:一种使用通用片段引物的敏捷牛津纳米孔测序工作流程
source_body_en: Abstract Background Influenza A is a segmented negative-sense RNA virus with eight genomic segments. Efficient genome characterization is essential for molecular surveillance and public health decision-making. Universal primers targeting conserved terminal regions enable amplification of all segments within a single workflow, supporting rapid sequencing and genotype assignment. This study aimed to standardize and evaluate a universal-primer Oxford Nanopore workflow for Influenza A genotyping, including real-time monitoring and post-run clade assignment. Methods Residual eluates from respiratory samples collected between October and November 2025 that tested positive for Influenza A by qPCR were used for genomic surveillance. Samples were de-identified and submitted to cDNA synthesis (High-Capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription Kit) supplemented with universal primers targeting conserved terminal regions. Amplicon enrichment was performed with the same primer sets and Q5® High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix; products were assessed by agarose gel electrophoresis. Barcoding used a transposition-based approach, libraries were adapter-ligated, and sequencing was performed on MinION flowcells. Real-time monitoring was performed with RAMPART. Consensus generation was performed in EPI2ME, followed by clade/genotype analysis using Nextclade for Influenza A(H3N2) HA and NA against reference A/Darwin/6/2021. Results A library of 95 samples was sequenced for 5 hours and 31 minutes, generating 752,910 reads. Using predefined criteria for near-complete genome recovery (minimum 20× depth and =75% horizontal genome coverage), 71/95 samples met the established metrics. Four samples produced no mapped reads. The remaining 20 samples yielded partial genome recovery with mean horizontal coverage of 52% (range 8.08%–74.94%). Despite incomplete whole-genome recovery in a subset, clade-level genotyping was achieved for 87/95 samples (91.6%), indicating that sufficient subtype/clade-informative sequence was obtained for most specimens. Eight samples were not genotyped: four due to absence of mapped reads and four due to insufficient coverage to support confident assignment. Conclusion This universal-primer Nanopore workflow enabled rapid, high-throughput Influenza A genotyping with real-time monitoring and high clade-assignment success (91.6%) in a single MinION run. QC thresholds of 20× depth and =75% horizontal coverage effectively identified samples suitable for near-complete genome recovery, while clade assignment remained feasible for most samples despite heterogeneous input quality. This approach supports agile clinical-laboratory surveillance with scalable implementation.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 流感A病毒是一种具有八个基因组片段的分节负链RNA病毒。对分子特征进行高效鉴定对于公共卫生决策至关重要。针对保守末端区域的通用引物能够在单一工作流程中扩增所有片段,支持快速测序和基因型分配。本研究旨在标准化并评估一种针对流感A病毒基因型鉴定的通用引物牛津纳米孔测序工作流程,包括实时监测和运行后分支分配。方法 使用2025年10月至11月期间通过qPCR检测出流感A病毒的呼吸道样本残余洗脱液进行基因组监测。样本去标识化后,使用High-Capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription Kit进行cDNA合成,并补充针对保守末端区域的通用引物。使用相同的引物集合和Q5® High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix进行扩增子富集;产物通过琼脂糖凝胶电泳进行评估。条形码使用基于转座的策略,库通过接头连接,测序在MinION流细胞上进行。实时监测使用RAMPART进行。共识生成在EPI2ME中完成,随后使用Nextclade对流感甲型H3N2流感病毒的HA和NA进行分支/基因型分析,参考A/Darwin/6/2021。结果 对95个样本进行了5小时31分钟的测序,生成了752,910条读数。根据预定义的标准(最小20×深度和=75%水平基因组覆盖),71/95个样本符合已建立的指标。4个样本未产生任何映射读数。其余20个样本产生了部分基因组恢复,平均水平覆盖率为52%(范围8.08%–74.94%)。尽管部分样本未能实现完整的基因组恢复,仍有87/95个样本(91.6%)实现了分支水平的基因型鉴定,表明大多数样本获得了足够的亚型/分支信息序列。8个样本未进行基因型鉴定:其中4个因无映射读数,另外4个因覆盖不足而无法进行可靠分配。结论 这种通用引物的纳米孔测序工作流程能够在单次MinION运行中实现快速、高通量的流感A病毒基因型鉴定,同时具备实时监测和高分支分配成功率(91.6%)。20×深度和=75%水平覆盖的质控阈值有效识别了适合近完全基因组恢复的样本,尽管输入质量存在异质性,大多数样本仍能进行分支分配。这种方法支持临床实验室的敏捷监测,并具有可扩展的实施能力。

title: ATTITUDES AND PRACTICES TOWARDS COVID-19 AND SEASONAL FLU VACCINES AND VACCINATION IN THE GENERAL POPULATION AND AMONG MEDICAL PROFESSIONALS
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has led to the development of several types of vaccines, among which messenger RNA (mRNA)-based vaccines have represented a significant breakthrough. This study aimed to evaluate attitudes towards COVID-19 and seasonal influenza vaccination among the general population and individuals with a medical background. A questionnaire was developed to collect sociodemographic data, personal health information, vaccination status, and information on participants’ attitudes towards and knowledge of vaccines. The profile of the typical participant was an employed woman with tertiary education, living with another person in an urban area and reporting generally good health. The typical participant had received at least two doses of the Sputnik V vaccine. Participants generally expressed favourable attitudes towards regular COVID-19 vaccination. The results showed no apparent differences between participants with and without a medical background regarding vaccine choice, the decision to receive a third dose, or seasonal influenza vaccination. Similarly, no apparent differences were observed in attitudes towards the AstraZeneca vaccine or mandatory COVID-19 vaccination between respondents with and without a medical background.

title: Aircraft wastewater virome surveillance from domestic and international flights reveals viral diversity among travellers: A proof-of-concept study from Gujarat, India.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Aircraft wastewater surveillance (AWS) at airports is an emerging method for detecting pathogens shed by international and domestic travellers. Global spread of infectious diseases occurs rapidly through air travel, and implementing surveillance systems at airports can help identify emerging viruses and track pathogens at scale. We aimed to characterize the viral diversity shed by travellers, which may represent routine viral circulation or active infection, at Ahmedabad airport in Gujarat. METHODS: We collected wastewater samples from domestic and international terminals where domestic flights connect to 18 states and 3 Union Territories, while international flights operate across 16 destinations in 11 countries. Samples were collected from June 2024 to November 2025. We used a capture probe-based enrichment approach for virome surveillance and detected multiple viruses of public health importance. RESULTS: We identified a total of 40 viral families and 315 viral species, with a median of 71 genomes/segments detected per sample in domestic wastewater and 48.5 genomes/segments per sample in international wastewater. We detected several respiratory and enteric viruses, including Influenza A virus, SARS-CoV-2, Human mastadenovirus A, Human mastadenovirus B, Noroviruses, Rotavirus A, Hepatitis A virus, Astrovirus MLB1, Human mastadenovirus F. Among these, certain viruses showed relatively higher mean RPKMF abundance in either domestic or international wastewater samples such as Bovine rotavirus A, Human rotavirus ID45/2, and BK polyomavirus observed in international wastewater samples, whereas Aichivirus A1, Norovirus GII.2, and Human immunodeficiency virus 1 showed higher abundance in domestic wastewater samples. We also detected multiple Influenza virus subtypes, including Influenza A subtypes H1N1, H3N2, H5N1, H7N1, and H9N2, along with Influenza B and Influenza C viruses. CONCLUSIONS: Continuous surveillance can provide early warning signals to public health authorities, timely decision-making and coordinated responses can reduce the spread of disease which also requires collaboration with national and international health authorities.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to characterize the viral diversity shed by travellers at Ahmedabad airport in Gujarat using aircraft wastewater surveillance. Wastewater samples were collected from domestic and international terminals between June 2024 and November 2025. The methods involved a capture probe-based enrichment approach to detect multiple viruses of public health importance. The main results showed the identification of 40 viral families and 315 viral species, with a median of 71 genomes/segments detected per sample in domestic wastewater and 48.5 genomes/segments per sample in international wastewater. The study detected several respiratory and enteric viruses, including Influenza A virus, SARS-CoV-2, and others. It also identified multiple Influenza virus subtypes, such as H1N1, H3N2, H5N1, H7N1, and H9N2, along with Influenza B and Influenza C viruses. The authors concluded that continuous surveillance can provide early warning signals to public health authorities, enabling timely decision-making and coordinated responses to reduce disease spread. The findings suggest that wastewater surveillance at airports can be a valuable tool for monitoring viral diversity and detecting emerging pathogens, which may inform public health strategies for disease prevention and control. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 飞机废水监测(AWS)在机场是一种新兴的检测国际和国内旅行者传播病原体的方法。通过航空旅行,传染病在全球范围内迅速传播,而在机场实施监测系统有助于识别新出现的病毒并大规模追踪病原体。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们旨在表征在古吉拉特邦艾哈迈达巴德机场传播的旅行者病毒多样性,这可能代表常规病毒循环或活跃感染。我们从国内和国际航站楼采集废水样本,其中国内航班连接至18个州和3个联邦直辖区,而国际航班则运营至11个国家的16个目的地。
elements_zh.methods: 我们采用基于捕获探针的富集方法对病毒组监测进行分析,并检测了多种具有公共卫生重要性的病毒。样本采集时间为2024年6月至2025年11月。

title_zh: 飞机废水病毒组监测揭示旅行者中的病毒多样性:一项来自印度古吉拉特邦的可行性研究。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Aircraft wastewater surveillance (AWS) at airports is an emerging method for detecting pathogens shed by international and domestic travellers. Global spread of infectious diseases occurs rapidly through air travel, and implementing surveillance systems at airports can help identify emerging viruses and track pathogens at scale. We aimed to characterize the viral diversity shed by travellers, which may represent routine viral circulation or active infection, at Ahmedabad airport in Gujarat. METHODS: We collected wastewater samples from domestic and international terminals where domestic flights connect to 18 states and 3 Union Territories, while international flights operate across 16 destinations in 11 countries. Samples were collected from June 2024 to November 2025. We used a capture probe-based enrichment approach for virome surveillance and detected multiple viruses of public health importance. RESULTS: We identified a total of 40 viral families and 315 viral species, with a median of 71 genomes/segments detected per sample in domestic wastewater and 48.5 genomes/segments per sample in international wastewater. We detected several respiratory and enteric viruses, including Influenza A virus, SARS-CoV-2, Human mastadenovirus A, Human mastadenovirus B, Noroviruses, Rotavirus A, Hepatitis A virus, Astrovirus MLB1, Human mastadenovirus F. Among these, certain viruses showed relatively higher mean RPKMF abundance in either domestic or international wastewater samples such as Bovine rotavirus A, Human rotavirus ID45/2, and BK polyomavirus observed in international wastewater samples, whereas Aichivirus A1, Norovirus GII.2, and Human immunodeficiency virus 1 showed higher abundance in domestic wastewater samples. We also detected multiple Influenza virus subtypes, including Influenza A subtypes H1N1, H3N2, H5N1, H7N1, and H9N2, along with Influenza B and Influenza C viruses. CONCLUSIONS: Continuous surveillance can provide early warning signals to public health authorities, timely decision-making and coordinated responses can reduce the spread of disease which also requires collaboration with national and international health authorities.
abstract_zh: 背景:机场的飞机废水监测(AWS)是一种新兴的检测国际和国内旅行者传播病原体的方法。通过航空旅行,传染病在全球范围内迅速传播,而在机场实施监测系统有助于识别新出现的病毒并大规模追踪病原体。我们旨在表征在古吉拉特邦艾哈迈达巴德机场传播的旅行者病毒多样性,这可能代表常规病毒循环或活跃感染。方法:我们从国内和国际航站楼采集废水样本,其中国内航班连接至18个州和3个联邦直辖区,而国际航班则运营至11个国家的16个目的地。样本采集时间为2024年6月至2025年11月。我们采用基于捕获探针的富集方法对病毒组监测进行分析,并检测了多种具有公共卫生重要性的病毒。结果:我们共鉴定出40个病毒家族和315种病毒,国内废水样本中每份检测到的基因组/片段中位数为71个,国际废水样本中为48.5个。我们检测到了多种呼吸道和肠道病毒,包括甲型流感病毒、SARS-CoV-2、人腺病毒A型、人腺病毒B型、诺如病毒、A型轮状病毒、甲型肝炎病毒、MLB1型星状病毒、人腺病毒F型。其中,某些病毒在国内外废水样本中表现出相对较高的平均RPKMF丰度,例如国际废水样本中检测到的牛轮状病毒A型、人轮状病毒ID45/2型和BK多瘤病毒,而A型甲型肝炎病毒、诺如病毒GII.2型和人类免疫缺陷病毒1型则在国内外废水样本中丰度较高。我们还检测到了多种流感病毒亚型,包括甲型流感病毒H1N1、H3N2、H5N1、H7N1和H9N2亚型,以及乙型和丙型流感病毒。结论:持续的监测可以为公共卫生部门提供早期预警信号,及时的决策和协调响应可以减少疾病的传播,这也需要与国家和国际卫生部门合作。

title: Contact behavior and serological evidence of influenza reinfection across three post-COVID-19 pandemic seasons in a nationwide German cohort.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Influenza remains a global public health burden. While interpersonal contacts drive transmission, their association with individual-level reinfection risk is not well quantified, particularly in the post-COVID-19 period. We assessed the relationship between contact frequency and serological evidence of influenza reinfection across three consecutive seasons. METHODS: In this multicentre, population-based panel study conducted between 2020 and 2024, binding antibody titers against hemagglutinin antigens of three influenza subtypes (A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B) were measured by a bead-based multiplex immunoassay. Serological evidence of influenza reinfection was defined by fold-changes relative to the preceding season; with adjustments to minimize misclassification due to influenza vaccination. Logistic regression models were designed to estimate crude odds ratios (ORs) and DAG-informed adjusted odds ratios (aORs) for reinfection associated with total, household, and non-household contacts. RESULTS: Serological reinfection was detected in 14% (2021/22), 17% (2022/23), and 12% (2023/24) of participants. Among self-reported unvaccinated participants, reinfection was detected in 6%, 13% and 17% across the respective seasons. Non-household contacts were associated with increased odds of reinfection in one season (2022/23: aOR 1.008, 95% CI 1.002-1.014), while household contacts were associated with higher odds of reinfection in two seasons (2022/23: aOR 1.285, 95% CI 0.905-1.823; 2023/24: aOR 1.267, 95% CI 0.685-2.343). CONCLUSIONS: Serological evidence of reinfection among unvaccinated participants in comparison with all participants aligned more closely with surveillance data in 2021/22. Residual misclassification of vaccination or preceding infections may partly explain the absence of an association in 2021/22. Associations between contact behavior and reinfection were season-specific, with household contacts showing the strongest and most consistent effects.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Influenza remains a global public health burden. While interpersonal contacts drive transmission, their association with individual-level reinfection risk is not well quantified, particularly in the post-COVID-19 period.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This multicentre, population-based panel study was conducted between 2020 and 2024 in a nationwide German cohort. It included participants who were assessed for serological evidence of influenza reinfection across three consecutive seasons.
analysis.methods: Binding antibody titers against hemagglutinin antigens of three influenza subtypes (A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B) were measured by a bead-based multiplex immunoassay. analysis.main_results: Serological reinfection was detected in 14% (2021/22), 17% (2022/23), and 12% (2023/24) of participants. Among self-reported unvaccinated participants, reinfection was detected in 6%, 13%, and 17% across the respective seasons.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Associations between contact behavior and reinfection were season-specific, with household contacts showing the strongest and most consistent effects.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the role of contact behavior in influenza reinfection, which can inform targeted public health interventions and surveillance strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Residual misclassification of vaccination or preceding infections may partly explain the absence of an association in 2021/22. The evidence is moderate due to potential biases and limitations in serological classification.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the relationship between contact behavior and serological evidence of influenza reinfection in a nationwide German cohort across three post-COVID-19 pandemic seasons. The research aimed to quantify how interpersonal contacts influence individual reinfection risk. Using a bead-based multiplex immunoassay, antibody titers against influenza A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B subtypes were measured. The results showed varying reinfection rates across seasons, with household contacts consistently linked to higher odds of reinfection. The study highlights the season-specific nature of contact behavior's impact on reinfection and suggests potential biases in serological classification. These findings could inform public health strategies by emphasizing the importance of contact patterns in influenza transmission dynamics.

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This multicentre, population-based panel study was conducted between 2020 and 2024 in a nationwide German cohort. It included participants who were assessed for serological evidence of influenza reinfection across three consecutive seasons.
analysis_en.methods: Binding antibody titers against hemagglutinin antigens of three influenza subtypes (A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B) were measured by a bead-based multiplex immunoassay. title_zh: Contact behavior and serological evidence of influenza reinfection across three post-COVID-19 pandemic seasons in a nationwide German cohort.
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Influenza remains a global public health burden. While interpersonal contacts drive transmission, their association with individual-level reinfection risk is not well quantified, particularly in the post-COVID-19 period. We assessed the relationship between contact frequency and serological evidence of influenza reinfection across three consecutive seasons. METHODS: In this multicentre, population-based panel study conducted between 2020 and 2024, binding antibody titers against hemagglutinin antigens of three influenza subtypes (A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B) were measured by a bead-based multiplex immunoassay. Serological evidence of influenza reinfection was defined by fold-changes relative to the preceding season; with adjustments to minimize misclassification due to influenza vaccination. Logistic regression models were designed to estimate crude odds ratios (ORs) and DAG-informed adjusted odds ratios (aORs) for reinfection associated with total, household, and non-household contacts. RESULTS: Serological reinfection was detected in 14% (2021/22), 17% (2022/23), and 12% (2023/24) of participants. Among self-reported unvaccinated participants, reinfection was detected in 6%, 13% and 17% across the respective seasons. Non-household contacts were associated with increased odds of reinfection in one season (2022/23: aOR 1.008, 95% CI 1.002-1.014), while household contacts were associated with higher odds of reinfection in two seasons (2022/23: aOR 1.285, 95% CI 0.905-1.823; 2023/24: aOR 1.267, 95% CI 0.685-2.343). CONCLUSIONS: Serological evidence of reinfection among unvaccinated participants in comparison with all participants aligned more closely with surveillance data in 2021/22. Residual misclassification of vaccination or preceding infections may partly explain the absence of an association in 2021/22. Associations between contact behavior and reinfection were season-specific, with household contacts showing the strongest and most consistent effects.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项多中心、基于人群的面板研究,于2020年至2024年间在德国全国性队列研究中进行。研究对象包括在三个连续季节中被评估流感再感染血清学证据的参与者。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过基于珠子的多重免疫测定法测量了针对三种流感亚型(A(H1N1)、甲型H3N2流感病毒和B)血凝抗原的结合抗体滴度。设计了逻辑回归模型,以估计与总接触、家庭接触和非家庭接触相关的流感再感染的粗略比值比(ORs)和基于DAG的调整比值比(aORs)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在参与者中,分别有14%(2021/22)、17%(2022/23)和12%(2023/24)检测到血清学再感染。在自述未接种疫苗的参与者中,再感染率分别为6%、13%和17%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 接触行为与再感染之间的关联具有季节性,家庭接触显示出最强且最一致的影响。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了关于接触行为在流感再感染中作用的见解,可以为有针对性的公共卫生干预措施和监测策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于疫苗接种或先前感染的残留误分类,可能部分解释了2021/22赛季无关联的现象。由于血清学分类中可能存在偏倚和局限性,证据强度中等。

title: Study of Molecular Genetic Characteristics of Influenza A(H1N1) Viruses Identified During Monitoring in Kazakhstan (2023–2026)
abstract: Background/Objectives: Seasonal influenza threatens global public health through rapid mutations. This study evaluated the prevalence and molecular-genetic characteristics of seasonal influenza viruses circulating in Kazakhstan during the 2023–2026 epidemic seasons. Methods: Nasopharyngeal swabs (n = 1756) and serum samples (n = 718) were screened using RT-qPCR, HI, and ELISA assays. Selected A(H1N1)pdm09 isolates underwent full-length HA and NA gene next-generation sequencing, followed by phylogenetic and phenotypic analyses. Results: Influenza A(H3N2) strains dominated in Kazakhstan during the 2023–2024 and 2025–2026 seasons. Conversely, the 2024–2025 season showed a shifting landscape, characterized by co-circulation of influenza B and A(H1N1)pdm09 strains belonging to genetic clade 6B.1A.5a.2a (subclades C.1.9 and C.1.9.3). Mutational mapping revealed ongoing in situ microevolution adjacent to the receptor-binding site (HA-R222K). Genomic screening of the NA gene identified critical I223R and S247N mutations traditionally linked to resistance. In silico profiling predicted that while the majority maintained baseline sensitivity, the solitary A/Shymkent/NRL-1999/2024 isolate harboring the I223R substitution exhibited a multidrug-resistant genotype to oseltamivir, peramivir, and zanamivir. Conclusions: These findings demonstrate dynamic inter-seasonal etiological shifts and the predicted emergence of an independent resistant lineage (NA-I223R). This underscores the necessity for continuous, expanded genomic surveillance of respiratory pathogens across Kazakhstan.

abstract_zh: 背景/目的:季节性流感通过快速突变威胁全球公共卫生。本研究评估了2023–2026年流行季节期间在哈萨克斯坦流行的季节性流感病毒的患病率和分子遗传特征。方法:通过RT-qPCR、HI和ELISA检测方法对1756份鼻咽拭子样本和718份血清样本进行了筛查。选取的甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09分离株进行了全长HA和NA基因的下一代测序,随后进行了系统发育和表型分析。结果:2023–2024和2025–2026流行季节期间,哈萨克斯坦主要流行的是流感甲型H3N2流感病毒毒株。相反,2024–2025流行季节呈现出变化趋势,表现为流感B毒株与属于遗传簇6B.1A.5a.2a(亚簇C.1.9和C.1.9.3)的甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09毒株共同流行。突变图谱显示,在受体结合位点(HA-R222K)附近持续发生局部微进化。对NA基因的基因组筛查发现了传统上与抗药性相关的I223R和S247N 突变突变。计算机模拟分析预测,尽管大多数毒株保持基础敏感性,但单独携带I223R突变的A/Shymkent/NRL-1999/2024毒株对奥司他韦、拉米夫定和扎那米韦表现出多重耐药基因型。结论:这些发现表明了不同流行季节间病原体的动态变化,并预测了独立耐药谱系(NA-I223R)的出现。这强调了在哈萨克斯坦对呼吸道病原体进行持续、扩展的基因组监测监测的必要性。

title: Comparative immunogenicity and relative vaccine efficacy of recombinant and cell culture-based influenza vaccines: Results from a randomized trial of adults in the United States, 2024-2025
abstract: Background: Recombinant (RIV) and cell culture-based inactivated (ccIIV) influenza vaccines could improve seasonal influenza prevention; however, evidence is limited in how protection may differ among non-egg-based vaccines. Methods: We conducted a randomized trial of RIV versus ccIIV to compare vaccine immunogenicity in adults aged 18 to 64 years during the 2024-25 influenza season (ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT06518577 ). Active surveillance for influenza-like illness was conducted for six months post-vaccination and cumulative incidence of influenza by vaccine type was compared to estimate relative vaccine efficacy. Participants were tested for influenza by reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction or rapid antigen tests. Immunogenicity was evaluated by hemagglutination inhibition (HAI), virus microneutralization (MN), and neuraminidase inhibition (NAI) assays in a subset of blood specimens collected pre-vaccination and one-month post-vaccination. Results: Among the 591 participants, 25 cases of influenza A were detected; 2.4% cumulative incidence among RIV recipients versus 6.1% among ccIIV recipients. The probability of influenza was 61% lower with RIV than ccIIV (95% confidence interval: 7 to 84). Among 151 participants, post-vaccination HAI and MN titers vaccine components were higher among RIV recipients while NAI titers were higher among ccIIV recipients. Conclusions: RIV provided better protection than ccIIV against influenza A illness in adults during the U.S.

abstract_zh: 背景:重组(RIV)和基于细胞培养的灭活(ccIIV)流感疫苗可能改善流感预防;然而,关于非蛋基流感疫苗保护效果差异的证据有限。方法:我们进行了一项随机对照试验,比较RIV与ccIIV在2024-25流感季节18至64岁成人中的免疫原性(ClinicalTrials.gov,NCT06518577)。在接种疫苗后六个月,对流感样疾病的主动监测,并比较不同流感病毒类型引起的流感累积发病率,以估计相对疫苗效力。参与者通过逆转录聚合酶链反应或快速抗原检测进行流感诊断。免疫原性通过血凝抑制(HAI)、病毒微中和(MN)和神经氨酸酶抑制(NAI)试验在部分接种前和接种后一个月采集的血液样本中进行评估。结果:在591名参与者中,检测到25例流感A型病例;RIV接种者的累积发病率为2.4%,而ccIIV接种者为6.1%。RIV相较于ccIIV降低流感发生概率61%(95%置信区间:7至84)。在151名参与者中,接种后RIV接种者的血凝抑制和中和抗体滴度高于ccIIV接种者,而神经氨酸酶抑制滴度则更高。结论:在2024-25流感季节,RIV在成人中对流感A型疾病的保护效果优于ccIIV。

title: Recurring Temporal Association Between Influenza A Epidemics and Subsequent Influenza B Dominance in Post-Pandemic Korea, 2022-2026.
abstract: Post-pandemic influenza dynamics have shown unusual patterns globally. We investigated the re-emergence and recurrent seasonal dominance of influenza B in Korea across three post-pandemic seasons (2022-2026). We analyzed 157 consecutive weeks of national sentinel surveillance data (K-SenS, Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency), covering September 2022 to August 2025, plus preliminary data through Week 10 of 2026. Influenza B predominance was defined as weeks with > 50% influenza B among total influenza detections; a sensitivity analysis required overall influenza activity > 5%. Influenza B activity remained minimal during the 2022-23 season (mean proportion 3.3%; peak 25.3%) and never reached predominance. Two complete predominance episodes followed influenza A epidemics: after the 2023-24 epidemic (co-circulating A/H1N1pdm09 and A/H3N2; peak ILI 61.3/1000), B predominance began January 2024 and persisted 23 weeks (peak 100%); after the 2024-25A/H1N1pdm09-dominant epidemic (peak ILI 99.8/1000), it began February 2025 and accumulated 20 weeks over two periods with a brief interruption (peak 100%). Onset occurred 5-8 weeks after the influenza A peak by ILI (6-8 weeks virologically) in all three episodes, unaffected by threshold choice. A third episode following the 2025-26A/H3N2 epidemic was ongoing as of March 2026 (onset 7 weeks after the A peak). In post-pandemic Korea, influenza B repeatedly established seasonal dominance 5-8 weeks after influenza A epidemics across three consecutive seasons. This recurring temporal pattern may have implications for influenza surveillance, clinical preparedness, and vaccine strategy, though its underlying mechanism remains unestablished.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the recurring temporal association between influenza A epidemics and subsequent influenza B dominance in post-pandemic Korea from 2022 to 2026. Using national sentinel surveillance data, it identifies two episodes of influenza B predominance following influenza A outbreaks, with each episode beginning 5-8 weeks after the A peak. The findings suggest a potential pattern that could influence influenza surveillance, clinical preparedness, and vaccine strategy, though the underlying mechanism remains unclear. The study's evidence is moderate due to its observational nature and lack of experimental validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 后疫情时代流感的动态变化在全球范围内表现出异常模式。我们研究了韩国在三个后疫情时代季节(2022-2026)中流感B病毒的重新出现及其反复的季节性主导现象。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了157周连续的国家哨兵监测数据(K-SenS,韩国疾病控制与预防署),涵盖2022年9月至2025年8月,以及2026年第10周的初步数据。研究聚焦于韩国在三个后疫情时代季节中流感B病毒的主导情况。在2022-23季节,流感B活动水平保持较低,从未达到主导状态。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究利用国家哨兵监测数据分析流感活动,将流感B病毒活动占比超过50%的周定义为流感B主导。敏感性分析要求总体流感活动强度超过5%。
elements_zh.main_results: 在两次流感A流行之后出现了完整的流感B主导期:在2023-24季节(同时流行A/H1N1pdm09和A/H3N2;ILI峰值61.3/1000)之后,流感B主导始于2024年1月并持续了23周(峰值100%);在2024-25季节以A/H1N1pdm09为主导的流行(ILI峰值99.8/1000)之后,流感B主导始于2025年2月,并在两个时期累计持续了20周,中间有一次短暂中断(峰值100%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究观察到,在三个连续季节中,流感B病毒在流感A流行后5-8周反复建立季节性主导。这种反复的时间模式可能对流感监测、临床准备以及疫苗策略产生影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为后疫情时代韩国的流感监测策略、临床准备和疫苗规划提供信息,强调了监测流感A和B主导之间时间关系的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于监测数据,未能确定所观察模式的潜在机制。由于依赖观察性数据而非实验验证,证据强度中等。

title: Structural characterization and antiviral activity of polysaccharide from Codonopsis pilosula.
abstract: Codonopsis polysaccharides exhibit diverse biological activities, but their antiviral effects against the H1N1 influenza A virus and how these activities change after sulfation modification remains unclear. In this study, crude Codonopsis polysaccharide (COP) was obtained via water extraction and alcohol precipitation, and COP-1 (2.1 × 103 Da, β-D-(2 → 1)-fructan) was isolated and purified. Both COP and COP-1 were modified by sulfation using the sulfur trioxide-pyridine method, yielding derivatives SCOP and SCOP-1 with degrees of substitution of 1.792 and 1.403, respectively. Antiviral activity was evaluated in MDCK cells using MTT and TCID50 assays, revealing that COP, SCOP, and SCOP-1 all inhibited H1N1 replication, with sulfation significantly enhancing antiviral activity. Time-of-addition experiments indicated that inhibition occurred during the early phase of infection (0-4 h). Annexin V-PI staining confirmed that these compounds reduced virus-induced early apoptosis. In H1N1-infected A549 cells, they suppressed NF-κB p65 phosphorylation and downregulated the expression of IL-6, IL-8, MCP-1, CCL-5, TNF-α, and TRAIL. Overall, Codonopsis polysaccharides and their sulfated derivatives exert anti-influenza effects through a triple mechanism involving inhibition of early viral replication, anti-apoptotic activity, and anti-inflammatory action, making them promising candidates for antiflu therapeutics.

source_records.abstract: Codonopsis polysaccharides exhibit diverse biological activities, but their antiviral effects against the H1N1 influenza A virus and how these activities change after sulfation modification remains unclear. In this study, crude Codonopsis polysaccharide (COP) was obtained via water extraction and alcohol precipitation, and COP-1 (2.1 × 103 Da, β-D-(2 → 1)-fructan) was isolated and purified. Both COP and COP-1 were modified by sulfation using the sulfur trioxide-pyridine method, yielding derivatives SCOP and SCOP-1 with degrees of substitution of 1.792 and 1.403, respectively. Antiviral activity was evaluated in MDCK cells using MTT and TCID50 assays, revealing that COP, SCOP, and SCOP-1 all inhibited H1N1 replication, with sulfation significantly enhancing antiviral activity. Time-of-addition experiments indicated that inhibition occurred during the early phase of infection (0-4 h). Annexin V-PI staining confirmed that these compounds reduced virus-induced early apoptosis. In H1N1-infected A549 cells, they suppressed NF-κB p65 phosphorylation and downregulated the expression of IL-6, IL-8, MCP-1, CCL-5, TNF-α, and TRAIL. Overall, Codonopsis polysaccharides and their sulfated derivatives exert anti-influenza effects through a triple mechanism involving inhibition of early viral replication, anti-apoptotic activity, and anti-inflammatory action, making them promising candidates for antiflu therapeutics.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the antiviral effects of Codonopsis polysaccharides and their sulfated derivatives against the H1N1 influenza A virus. The research aimed to clarify the biological activities of these compounds and how sulfation modifies their antiviral potential. The study involved isolating and purifying crude polysaccharides, modifying them through sulfation, and evaluating their antiviral activity in MDCK cells. Results showed that all tested compounds inhibited H1N1 replication, with sulfation significantly enhancing this effect. Time-of-addition experiments suggested that inhibition occurs during the early phase of infection, and annexin V-PI staining confirmed reduced virus-induced apoptosis. Additionally, the compounds suppressed NF-κB p65 phosphorylation and downregulated inflammatory markers in infected A549 cells. These findings suggest that Codonopsis polysaccharides and their derivatives may offer a promising therapeutic approach for influenza treatment. However, the study is limited to in vitro experiments, and further research is needed to validate these results in vivo and in clinical settings.

abstract_zh: 党参多糖表现出多种生物活性,但其对甲型H1N1流感病毒的抗病毒药物作用及其在硫酸化修饰后活性的变化仍不清楚。本研究通过水提醇沉法获得粗党参多糖(COP),并分离纯化出COP-1(2.1 × 103 Da,β-D-(2 → 1)-果聚糖)。采用三氧化硫-吡啶法对COP和COP-1进行硫酸化修饰,得到取代度分别为1.792和1.403的衍生物SCOP和SCOP-1。通过MTT和TCID50实验在MDCK细胞中评估抗病毒药物活性,结果显示COP、SCOP和SCOP-1均抑制了H1N1病毒的复制,硫酸化显著增强了抗病毒药物活性。时间添加实验表明,抑制作用发生在感染早期阶段(0-4小时)。通过Annexin V-PI染色确认这些化合物可减少病毒诱导的早期细胞凋亡。在H1N1感染的A549细胞中,它们抑制了NF-κB p65的磷酸化,并下调了IL-6、IL-8、MCP-1、CCL-5、TNF-α和TRAIL的表达。总体而言,党参多糖及其硫酸化衍生物通过抑制早期病毒复制、抗凋亡作用和抗炎作用三种机制发挥抗流感效果,显示出作为抗流感药物的潜力。

title: Shifts in acute respiratory pathogen epidemiology: an 8-year surveillance study in Hangzhou, China (2018–2025)
abstract: Objectives To analyze the epidemiological characteristics of six common respiratory pathogens in cases of Acute Respiratory Tract Infection (ARTI) in Hangzhou from 2018 to 2025, to provide a basis for clinical diagnosis and treatment, as well as public health prevention and control. Methods A multicenter retrospective study was conducted. Data from 81,974 ARTI cases from seven medical institutions in Hangzhou City between January 2018 and December 2025 were collected. Cases with positive test results were analyzed for influenza A virus (FluA), influenza B virus (FluB), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), adenovirus (ADV), Mycoplasma pneumoniae (MP), and Chlamydia pneumoniae (CP), and statistical analysis was performed according to the pandemic stage, age, sex, season, and co-infection status. Results Among 81,974 patients, a total of 33,350 cases tested positive for pathogens, with an overall positive rate of 40.68%. MP (19.56%) and FluA (16.93%) were the most prevalent pathogens. The positivity rates of each pathogen showed statistically significant differences across the three stages before, during, and after the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic (all P < 0.001). Compared with the pre-COVID-19 pandemic period (2018–2019), the positive rates of FluA, FluB, and MP were significantly suppressed during the COVID-19 pandemic period (2020–2022), and then experienced a sharp “revenge rebound” in the post-COVID-19 pandemic period (2023–2025) (for example, the positive rate of MP rebounded from 5.43% to 21.09%). In contrast, the positive rates of RSV, ADV, and CP showed a persistent state of inhibition, but the absolute number of cases far exceeded that of before the COVID-19 pandemic. MP had the highest infection rate among 6– < 12 years old (38.31%), whereas FluA was more common in adults. The epidemiological distribution showed obvious seasonal heterogeneity: FluA/FluB/RSV were more prevalent in winter, MP was active in autumn, and ADV was more prevalent in summer. The co-infection rate was 7.22% (5,922 cases), and the most common combination was FluA + MP, accounting for 53.82% of all co-infections. Conclusion From 2018 to 2025, the pathogen spectrum of ARTI in Hangzhou was mainly composed of MP and FluA. The COVID-19 pandemic and related non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) have had a profound and heterogeneous impact on the epidemic pattern of respiratory pathogens. FluA, FluB, and MP showed the characteristics of “suppression-retaliatory rebound.” In the post-COVID-19 pandemic era, the activity of pathogens has clear seasonal, age, and gender distribution patterns, and the rate of mixed infections is high. The research results suggest that a dynamic monitoring system needs to be established, and targeted prevention and control measures should be implemented for key individuals and pathogens during high-incidence seasons.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在分析2018年至2025年间杭州急性呼吸道感染(ARTI)病例中六种常见呼吸道病原体的流行病学特征,为临床诊断和治疗以及公共卫生预防和控制提供依据。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用多中心回顾性研究设计,使用了2018年1月至2025年12月期间杭州七家医疗机构收集的81,974例急性呼吸道感染(ARTI)病例数据。
elements_zh.methods: 收集了2018年1月至2025年12月期间杭州七家医疗机构报告的81,974例急性呼吸道感染(ARTI)病例数据。对流感A病毒(FluA)、流感B病毒(FluB)、呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)、腺病毒(ADV)、肺炎支原体(MP)和肺炎衣原体(CP)的阳性病例进行分析,并根据疫情阶段、年龄、性别、季节和混合感染状态进行统计分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在81,974名患者中,共有33,350例检测出病原体,总体阳性率为40.68%。每种病原体的阳性率在新冠疫情(Coronavirus Disease 2019,COVID-19)大流行前、期间和后三个阶段中均表现出统计学上的显著差异(所有P < 0.001)。与新冠疫情前(2018–2019年)相比,新冠疫情大流行期间(2020–2022年)流感A型(FluA)、流感B型(FluB)和支原体(MP)的阳性率显著下降,随后在新冠疫情后(2023–2025年)出现了急剧的"报复性反弹"(例如,支原体的阳性率从5.43%反弹至21.09%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,在疫情和疫情后时期,流感A病毒、流感B病毒和肺炎支原体表现出“抑制-报复性反弹”的特征,具有明显的季节性、年龄和性别分布模式,并且混合感染率较高。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要建立动态监测系统,并在高发季节对关键人群和病原体实施针对性的预防和控制措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究是一项回顾性分析,可能会引入偏倚并限制建立因果关系的能力。研究证据基于大规模数据集,结果通过统计分析支持,表明具有中等程度的可信度。

abstract_zh: 目的 分析2018年至2025年间杭州市急性呼吸道感染(ARTI)病例中六种常见呼吸道病原体的流行病学特征,为临床诊断和治疗以及公共卫生预防和控制提供依据。方法 开展了多中心回顾性研究。收集了2018年1月至2025年12月期间杭州市7家医疗机构的81,974例ARTI病例数据。对流感A病毒(FluA)、流感B病毒(FluB)、呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)、腺病毒(ADV)、肺炎支原体(MP)和肺炎衣原体(CP)的阳性病例进行分析,并根据疫情阶段、年龄、性别、季节和混合感染状态进行统计分析。结果 在81,974例患者中,共检测出33,350例病原体阳性病例,总体阳性率为40.68%。MP(19.56%)和FluA(16.93%)是最常见的病原体。每种病原体的阳性率在新冠疫情(COVID-19)爆发前、爆发期间和爆发后三个阶段均表现出统计学显著差异(所有P < 0.001)。与新冠疫情爆发前(2018–2019年)相比,新冠疫情爆发期间(2020–2022年)FluA、FluB和MP的阳性率显著下降,而在新冠疫情爆发后(2023–2025年)则出现了明显的‘报复性反弹’(例如,MP的阳性率从5.43%反弹至21.09%)。相比之下,RSV、ADV和CP的阳性率表现出持续抑制状态,但病例的绝对数量远高于新冠疫情爆发前。MP在6–<12岁人群中感染率最高(38.31%),而FluA在成人中更为常见。流行病学分布显示出明显的季节性差异:FluA/FluB/RSV在冬季更为常见,MP在秋季活跃,ADV则在夏季更为普遍。混合感染率为7.22%(5,922例),最常见的组合是FluA + MP,占所有混合感染的53.82%。结论 2018年至2025年间,杭州市ARTI的主要病原体谱系由MP和FluA组成。新冠疫情及其相关的非药物干预措施(NPIs)对呼吸道病原体的流行模式产生了深远且异质性的影响。FluA、FluB和MP表现出‘抑制-报复性反弹’的特征。在新冠疫情后时期,病原体的活动呈现出明显的季节性、年龄和性别分布模式,混合感染率较高。研究结果表明,需要建立动态监测系统,并在高发病率季节对关键人群和病原体实施针对性的预防和控制措施。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在分析2018年至2025年间杭州急性呼吸道感染(ARTI)病例中六种常见呼吸道病原体的流行病学特征,为临床诊断和治疗以及公共卫生预防和控制提供依据。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用多中心回顾性研究设计,使用了2018年1月至2025年12月期间杭州七家医疗机构收集的81,974例急性呼吸道感染(ARTI)病例数据。
analysis_zh.methods: 收集了2018年1月至2025年12月期间杭州七家医疗机构报告的81,974例急性呼吸道感染(ARTI)病例数据。对流感A病毒(FluA)、流感B病毒(FluB)、呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)、腺病毒(ADV)、肺炎支原体(MP)和肺炎衣原体(CP)的阳性病例进行分析,并根据疫情阶段、年龄、性别、季节和混合感染状态进行统计分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在81,974名患者中,共有33,350例检测出病原体,总体阳性率为40.68%。每种病原体的阳性率在新冠疫情(Coronavirus Disease 2019,COVID-19)大流行前、期间和后三个阶段中均表现出统计学上的显著差异(所有P < 0.001)。与新冠疫情前(2018–2019年)相比,新冠疫情大流行期间(2020–2022年)流感A型(FluA)、流感B型(FluB)和支原体(MP)的阳性率显著下降,随后在新冠疫情后(2023–2025年)出现了急剧的"报复性反弹"(例如,支原体的阳性率从5.43%反弹至21.09%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,在疫情和疫情后时期,流感A病毒、流感B病毒和肺炎支原体表现出“抑制-报复性反弹”的特征,具有明显的季节性、年龄和性别分布模式,并且混合感染率较高。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要建立动态监测系统,并在高发季节对关键人群和病原体实施针对性的预防和控制措施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究是一项回顾性分析,可能会引入偏倚并限制建立因果关系的能力。研究证据基于大规模数据集,结果通过统计分析支持,表明具有中等程度的可信度。

title: Receptor-binding geometry constrains viral antigenic evolution through fitness-evasion coupling.
abstract: UNLABELLED: Although viral antigenic evolution is shaped by the competing demands of immune evasion and receptor-binding fitness, the physical principles underlying divergent viral evolutionary dynamics remain poorly understood. Here, by integrating structural biology, deep mutational scanning, and genomic surveillance data, we show that receptor-binding geometry constrains the spatial coupling between antibody escape and intrinsic viral fitness. In SARS-CoV-2, the exposed convex Spike-ACE2 interface spatially overlaps dominant neutralizing epitopes with receptor-contact residues, producing a stringent fitness-evasion trade-off. Consequently, viable escape mutations are largely restricted to a narrow peripheral region surrounding the receptor-binding core. As population immunity progressively saturates this limited escape space, continued adaptation increasingly requires coordinated saltational remodeling of the receptor-binding interface. In contrast, the influenza H3N2 hemagglutinin binds the small sialic acid ligand through a recessed pocket architecture that partially separates dominant antibody pressure from receptor-binding fitness constraints. This topological decoupling permits continuous stepwise antigenic drift without requiring frequent remodeling of the core binding site. Building on these findings, we develop a lightweight geometry-based framework that accurately identifies receptor-competitive antigenic hotspots across divergent viruses. Together, our results support a general model in which receptor geometry and protein surface topology strongly bias accessible antigenic evolutionary trajectories. IMPORTANCE: Why some viruses evolve through gradual antigenic drift whereas others undergo recurrent evolutionary leaps remains a fundamental question in virology. By integrating protein structures, mutational scanning data, and genomic surveillance, we show that the geometry of the receptor-binding interface strongly influences how immune escape mutations affect viral fitness. In SARS-CoV-2, receptor-binding residues are highly exposed and overlap with dominant antibody targets, restricting immune escape to a narrow set of mutations and promoting periodic evolutionary leaps when this space becomes exhausted. In contrast, the receptor-binding pocket of influenza A virus H3N2 is partially shielded from antibody recognition, allowing continuous antigenic drift with fewer fitness constraints. We further demonstrate that these structural principles can be used to identify antigenic hotspots directly from virus-receptor complexes. These findings provide a mechanistic explanation for divergent viral evolutionary trajectories and offer a structural framework for studying and anticipating antigenic evolution.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the relationship between receptor-binding geometry and viral antigenic evolution, focusing on seasonal influenza viruses. It highlights how the spatial overlap between antibody targets and receptor-binding residues in SARS-CoV-2 creates a stringent fitness-evasion trade-off, restricting escape mutations to a narrow region and necessitating periodic evolutionary leaps. In contrast, influenza A(H3N2) has a recessed pocket that partially separates antibody pressure from receptor-binding fitness constraints, allowing continuous antigenic drift. The authors propose a geometry-based framework to identify antigenic hotspots directly from virus-receptor complexes, offering a novel structural model for understanding and predicting viral evolution. The study's conclusions are based on abstract-level evidence and integrated data, providing a moderate confidence assessment.

abstract_zh: 尽管病毒抗原性进化受到免疫逃逸和受体结合适应性的竞争需求的影响,但不同病毒进化动态背后的物理原理仍不明确。在这里,通过整合结构生物学、深度突变扫描和基因组监测数据,我们展示了受体结合几何结构如何限制抗体逃逸与内在病毒适应性之间的空间耦合。在SARS-CoV-2中,暴露的凸面刺突-ACE2界面与主要中和表位在空间上重叠,受体接触残基,从而产生严格的适应性逃逸权衡。因此,可行的逃逸突变主要局限于受体结合核心周围的狭窄外围区域。随着群体免疫逐渐填满这一有限的逃逸空间,持续适应越来越需要协调的受体结合界面突变重塑。相比之下,流感H3N2血凝素通过一个凹陷的口袋结构结合小的唾液酸配体,这种结构部分将主要抗体压力与受体结合适应性约束分离。这种拓扑解耦允许连续的逐步抗原漂移,而无需频繁重塑核心结合位点。基于这些发现,我们开发了一个轻量级的几何框架,能够准确识别不同病毒中的受体竞争性抗原热点。我们的结果共同支持了一个普遍模型,即受体几何结构和蛋白质表面拓扑结构强烈偏导可访问的抗原进化轨迹。重要性:为什么一些病毒通过渐进的抗原漂移进化,而另一些病毒则经历反复的进化跃迁,仍然是病毒学中的一个基本问题。通过整合蛋白质结构、突变扫描数据和基因组监测,我们展示了受体结合界面的几何结构如何影响免疫逃逸突变对病毒适应性的影响。在SARS-CoV-2中,受体结合残基高度暴露,并与主要抗体靶点重叠,限制了免疫逃逸突变的范围,并在该空间耗尽时促进周期性的进化跃迁。相比之下,流感A病毒H3N2的受体结合口袋部分被抗体识别所屏蔽,允许较少适应性约束下的连续抗原漂移。我们进一步证明,这些结构原理可用于直接从病毒-受体复合物中识别抗原热点。这些发现为病毒不同的进化轨迹提供了机制性解释,并为研究和预测抗原性进化提供了结构框架。

title: Avian influenza overview June-August 2026.
abstract: Between 5 June and 28 August 2026, 110 highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) A(H5N1) virus detections were reported in domestic (7) and wild (103) birds in 12 countries in Europe. The number of detections remained at a seasonal low throughout the summer, continuing the decline observed since spring. In contrast to previous years, fewer colony-breeding seabirds were affected, and the geographical range of detections was more limited. Further sporadic detections of HPAI A(H5) virus were reported in wild terrestrial carnivores and pinnipeds. Outside Europe, the epidemic continued in the Americas, where also the HPAI A(H7N3) subtype was detected in Mexico. Following its first introduction to mainland Australia, HPAI A(H5N1) virus spread within local wild bird populations and spilled over to terrestrial carnivores and marine mammals. In the US, the number of dairy cattle farms reportedly affected by HPAI A(H5N1) increased, while detections in captive American minks were reported for the first time. Between 5 June and 31 August 2026, 15 cases of avian influenza virus infection were publicly reported in humans (no fatal cases) in three countries and territories: Bangladesh (one A(H5N1) case), Cambodia (one A(H5N1) case) and China (13 A(H9N2) cases). All human cases reported exposure to poultry or a poultry environment prior to detection or onset of illness. Human infections with avian influenza viruses remain rare and no sustained human-to-human transmission has been documented. The risk posed by avian influenza A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b viruses currently circulating in Europe remains low for the general public in the European Union/European Economic Area (EU/EEA) and low-to-moderate for those occupationally or otherwise exposed to infected animals or contaminated environments.

title: H3 Subtype Avian Influenza Virus: Ecology, Cross-Species Evolution, and Public Health Threats
abstract: H3 subtype avian influenza virus (AIV) is one of the most widely distributed and frequently detected low-pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (LPAIVs) in wild birds and poultry worldwide. Wild waterfowl are the natural reservoir of this virus. In recent years, driven by frequent genetic reassortment and continuous evolution, H3 subtype AIV has expanded its host range to include various mammalian species—dogs, cats, horses, seals, pigs (experimental infection), and humans. Among these, the H3N8 subtype shows the broadest cross-species transmissibility, having established sustained transmission lineages in horses and dogs, while also causing sporadic infections in seals and humans. Avian-origin H3N2 canine influenza virus has circulated stably in dog populations across Asia and North America for nearly two decades. Between 2022 and 2023, China reported three human cases of H3N8 subtype AIV infection, one of which was fatal (Guangdong, March 2023), indicating that this virus poses a potential zoonotic transmission risk. Novel triple-reassortant strains, including genotype G25 of H3N8 and H3N3, first detected in chicken flocks in late 2022, have continued to emerge. Their HA genes originate from H3 subtype viruses of wild bird or chicken origin, whereas their internal gene segments are predominantly acquired from H9N2 subtype AIV, resulting in enhanced mammalian adaptability. This review summarizes the global epidemiology of H3 subtype AIV (covering wild birds, poultry, and live poultry markets), its genetic evolution and reassortment patterns, and the molecular mechanisms underlying cross-species transmission. This review particularly highlights the regulatory roles of key amino acid mutations—such as PB2-D701N, M1-M192V, and HA-Q226L/G228S—in receptor binding preference, polymerase activity, and pathogenicity. This review also summarizes recent advances in detection techniques (multiplex RT-PCR, quantum dot-based immunochromatographic strips, RT-RAA, and CRISPR-Cas13a) and vaccine development (inactivated, adenovirus-vectored, and mRNA vaccines). Key prevention and control challenges—including covert circulation, surveillance gaps, and limited subtyping diagnostic capacity at primary laboratories—are also discussed. This review proposes that H3 subtype AIV should be recognized as a potential zoonotic threat warranting continued surveillance, although no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission has been documented to date. Better understanding of cross-species mechanisms, stronger surveillance and early warning, and evidence-based control strategies are needed to inform future risk assessment.

title: Disseminated BCG disease and recurrent pulmonary infections in a child with trisomy 21 carrying a novel BACH2 variant of uncertain significance: a 5-year case report
abstract: Background Trisomy 21 is associated with combined immune dysregulation, including lymphopenia, impaired responses to vaccines, and heightened susceptibility to respiratory infections, driven in part by triplication of chromosome 21-encoded interferon receptor genes. BACH2 haploinsufficiency is a rare monogenic immunodeficiency characterized by lymphopenia, hypogammaglobulinemia, and susceptibility to infections and autoimmune diseases. Co-occurrence of these two conditions has not been previously described. Case presentation We report a 5-year longitudinal course in a Kenyan girl with trisomy 21, congenital heart disease, aspiration, and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) found via whole exome sequencing to carry a heterozygous BACH2 missense variant (c.1420C > G;p.Leu474Val) of uncertain significance; parental segregation remains incomplete. In silico protein structural modeling (FoldX and Missense3D) yielded discordant predictions of the variant's effect on the protein’s stability and structure. Additional in silico pathogenicity predictions were also inconsistent: Sorting Intolerant from Tolerant (SIFT), Evolutionary Model of Variant Effect (EVE), PolyPhen-2, and CADD Phred scores predicted pathogenicity, while REVEL and AlphaMissense suggested a lack of deleteriousness. Persistent panlymphopenia and profoundly low IgM levels were documented throughout the follow-up period. Over these 5 years, the girl sustained six hospitalized lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs), with four requiring intensive care, which were disseminated Bacille Calmette-Guérin (BCG) disease, respiratory syncytial virus and SARS-CoV-2 infections, and influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 pneumonia. Chest computed tomography at 4 years showed bilateral consolidations without bronchiectasis. Annual autoimmune screening remained negative. Conclusion This case illustrates the burden caused by severe and diverse respiratory pathogenic infections in a child with trisomy 21 and a candidate BACH2 variant. Trisomy 21 alone plausibly explains much of the phenotype; an independent contribution from the BACH2 variant remains unproven pending functional and segregation studies. Clinical considerations supported by this case include the potential value of prevaccination immunological screening to prevent BCG disease, equitable access to viral prophylaxis, and early specialist engagement in refractory cases.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Trisomy 21 is associated with combined immune dysregulation, including lymphopenia, impaired responses to vaccines, and heightened susceptibility to respiratory infections, driven in part by triplication of chromosome 21-encoded interferon receptor genes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A 5-year case report describes a Kenyan girl with trisomy 21, congenital heart disease, aspiration, and severe gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) who was found via whole exome sequencing to carry a heterozygous BACH2 missense variant (c.1420C > G;p.Leu474Val) of uncertain significance; parental segregation remains incomplete.
analysis.methods: The study involved longitudinal clinical observation, whole exome sequencing, and in silico protein structural modeling (FoldX and Missense3D) to assess the variant's effect on the protein’s stability and structure.
analysis.main_results: The girl sustained six hospitalized lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs) over 5 years, with four requiring intensive care, including disseminated BCG disease, respiratory syncytial virus and SARS-CoV-2 infections, and influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 pneumonia. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The case illustrates the burden caused by severe and diverse respiratory pathogenic infections in a child with trisomy 21 and a candidate BACH2 variant. The co-occurrence of these two conditions has not been previously described.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the potential value of prevaccination immunological screening to prevent BCG disease, equitable access to viral prophylaxis, and early specialist engagement in refractory cases.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited by the lack of functional and segregation studies to confirm an independent contribution from the BACH2 variant, and the findings are based on a single case report.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 5-year longitudinal study of a Kenyan girl with trisomy 21 and a novel BACH2 variant, who experienced severe respiratory infections, including influenza A(H1N1)pdm09. The study highlights the immune dysregulation associated with trisomy 21 and the potential impact of a BACH2 variant. The findings suggest the importance of prevaccination immunological screening and early specialist involvement in managing refractory infections. However, the evidence is limited by the absence of functional studies to confirm the variant's role. The case adds to the understanding of immune-related complications in trisomy 21 and underscores the need for further research on BACH2 variants in this context.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 三体综合征21号染色体与联合免疫失调有关,包括淋巴细胞减少、对疫苗的反应受损以及对呼吸道感染的易感性增加,这在一定程度上是由21号染色体编码的干扰素受体基因三倍体引起的。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项5年的随访描述了一名患有三体综合征21号染色体、先天性心脏病、误吸和严重胃食管反流病(GERD)的肯尼亚女孩,通过全外显子组测序发现其携带一个意义未明的BACH2杂合错义变异体(c.1420C > G;p.Leu474Val);父母的遗传分离尚未完全明确。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究包括纵向临床观察、全外显子组测序以及体外蛋白质结构建模(FoldX和Missense3D),以评估该变异体对蛋白质稳定性和结构的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 在5年期间,这名女孩经历了六次住院的下呼吸道感染(LRTIs),其中四次需要重症监护,包括播散性卡介苗(BCG)疾病、呼吸道合胞病毒和SARS-CoV-2感染,以及流感甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09肺炎。4岁时胸部计算机断层扫描显示双侧实变,但无支气管扩张。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该病例展示了三体综合征21号染色体和候选BACH2变异体的儿童所面临的严重且多样化的呼吸道病原体感染负担。这两种情况的共存尚未被描述过。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现突出了在预防BCG疾病前进行免疫学筛查的潜在价值、病毒预防药物的公平获取以及在难治性病例中早期专科介入的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于缺乏功能研究和遗传分离研究来确认BACH2变异体的独立贡献,证据有限,且这些发现基于单一的5年随访。

title: A study on the molecular profiling of viral pathogens among patients with acute respiratory tract infections at a tertiary care hospital in West Bengal, India
abstract: Background: Acute respiratory tract infection is a frequently acquired infection characterized by overlapping symptoms. It is a major cause of childhood mortality and morbidity. Molecular diagnostics such as real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) remain the practical gold standard to distinguish between such infections. However, there is a dearth of studies across India on molecular profiling of viral pathogens among respiratory tract infection patients. Therefore, this study was conducted for molecular surveillance of respiratory pathogens. Aims and Objectives: The current study aimed to (i) describe the demographic and clinical profile of patients with acute respiratory tract infections, (ii) determine the distribution of respiratory viral pathogens detected by RT-PCR. Materials and Methods: This was a retrospective, hospital-based, and observational study conducted from July 2025 to July 2026. A total of 127 patients were enrolled in the study; all samples enrolled were subjected to multiplex real-time RT-PCR. abstract_zh: 背景:急性呼吸道感染是一种常见感染,其症状相互重叠。它是儿童疾病和发病率的主要原因之一。分子诊断方法,如实时逆转录聚合酶链反应(RT-PCR),仍然是区分此类感染的实用金标准。然而,印度关于呼吸道感染患者呼吸道病毒病原体分子特征的研究却十分匮乏。因此,本研究旨在进行呼吸道病原体的分子 监测。研究目的和目标:本研究旨在(i)描述急性呼吸道感染患者的流行病学和临床特征,(ii)确定通过RT-PCR检测到的呼吸道病毒病原体的分布情况。材料和方法:本研究是一项回顾性、医院为基础的观察性研究,时间从2025年7月至2026年7月。共有127名患者参与了本研究;所有样本均接受了多重实时RT-PCR检测。结果:39名(30.7%)患者至少检测到一种病毒。在研究人群中,甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09的比例最高,占11例(28.2%),其次是呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)占9例(23.1%),以及甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09以外的甲型流感病毒B型占7例(17.9%)。结论:在症状不明确且相互重叠的病毒性感染中,呼吸道病毒的分子特征尤为重要,对于合理的抗菌药物使用、感染控制措施和公共卫生准备具有重要意义。

title: Detection of Influenza D Virus using Reverse Transcription Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification.
abstract: The Orthomyxoviridae family includes influenza D virus (IDV), an emerging pathogen primarily affecting cattle and swine; there is evidence of cross-species transmission and potential zoonotic risk. Although active human infections have yet to be confirmed, high seroprevalence in cattle-exposed populations highlights the need for continued surveillance. We developed and validated a rapid, field-deployable reverse transcription loop-mediated isothermal amplification assay for IDV detection; specificity was 99.2% and sensitivity ranged from 95.6% (cycle quantification <30) to 81.8% (cycle quantification <40). This method offers a cost-effective, accessible alternative to quantitative reverse transcription PCR, enabling improved monitoring of IDV and reinforcing preparedness for emerging influenza threats.

title: Unannounced Drills Using Patient Actors to Evaluate Health Care Facility Readiness for Infectious Disease Outbreaks - New Jersey, New York, and U.S. Virgin Islands, January-June 2026.
abstract: Unannounced drills using professional patient actors (mystery patients) have been used to evaluate health care facility management of patients with infectious diseases of public health concern. Ongoing outbreaks and the expanding role of urgent care centers highlight the need to evaluate the ability of health care facilities to rapidly identify, isolate, and safely manage patients with transmissible diseases. During January-June 2026, 73 drills were conducted in three jurisdictions within U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Region 2 (New Jersey, New York, and the U.S. Virgin Islands) using a simulated avian influenza A(H5) scenario. During these drills, facilities conducted symptom screening in 68 (93%) drills and obtained travel history upon patient arrival in 58 (80%) drills. Among 60 (82%) drills during which the patient was appropriately masked, the median interval from arrival at the facility to masking was 2 minutes (IQR = 1.0-6.0 minutes) (target = 1 minute), and among 52 (71%) drills during which the patient was isolated, the median interval from arrival to isolation was 11 minutes (IQR = 8.0-19.2 minutes) (target = 10 minutes). Both masking and isolation occurred in 44 (60%) drills. The clinical team planned to notify infection prevention and control teams in 40 (54%) drills. The clinician wore all recommended personal protective equipment in 17 (25%) drills. These drills provided an opportunity for facilities to examine implementation of the principles of identification, isolation, and informing. Findings from these drills will help guide future public health interventions to improve readiness among regional health care facilities for emerging and reemerging infectious disease threats.
journal: MMWR Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report

title: Immunological profile and antiviral therapy of influenza with account for virus serotype
abstract: The clinical efficacy of antiviral therapy (AVT) in moderate influenza, its dependence on virus serotype, and the contribution of interferon-inducer augmentation (kagocel) to the baseline regimen remain under active discussion. To characterise the immunological profile and clinical–laboratory efficacy of four AVT regimens in patients with moderate mono-influenza according to virus serotype and to evaluate the effect of Kagocel augmentation. 120 patients with laboratory-confirmed moderate influenza (30 per group: seasonal A(H1N1), A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), B) were examined in Vladivostok, 2016–2020. The control group comprised 31 apparently healthy donors. Four AVT regimens per serotype were used: umifenovir, umifenovir + kagocel, oseltamivir, oseltamivir + kagocel. Twenty-two immune, acute-phase, haematological and composite parameters (NLR, PLR, MLR, LMR, SII, SIRI) were assessed at admission (V1) and discharge (V2). Pronounced systemic hypercytokinaemia was documented (IL-17, IL-18, TNF-α, IFN-α, CRP; all q<10-13); the highest IL-10 and IFN-γ response was observed in A(H1N1)pdm09, the weakest – in A(H3N2). All regimens produced comparable decline of cytokines and inflammatory indices. The maximal clinical effect of kagocel augmentation was seen in A(H1N1)pdm09 and influenza B. All AVT regimens produced comparable suppression of systemic inflammation. The augmentation with Kagocel demonstrated a serotype-specific clinical advantage without an additional cytokine-modulating effect. The oseltamivir + kagocel regimen provides the best integrated clinical profile.
journal: Vestnik of North-Eastern Federal University Medical Sciences

title: A-125 TNF-a Mediates Post-Influenza Staphylococcus aureus Co-infection by Upregulating Platelet Activating Factor Receptor.
abstract: Abstract Background While secondary Staphylococcus aureus co-infection following influenza is a key factor leading to severe disease progression, its underlying molecular mechanisms remain insufficiently elucidated. This study aimed to elucidate the precise role and molecular mechanism of the TNF-a /PAFR axis in influenza A virus and Staphylococcus aureus co-infection. Methods Clinical analysis of serum samples was performed to compare TNF-a levels between IAV patients with and without bacterial co-infection. In vivo and in vitro co-infection models of influenza A virus (IAV) and Staphylococcus aureus were established to characterize clinical features and assess related molecular expression. To identify downstream effectors, transcriptomic sequencing of lung tissue was performed on TNF-a knockout mice. The functional role of PAFR was validated in vivo using the specific inhibitor WEB2086. A549 cells were stimulated with recombinant TNF-a, and the involvement of the NF-?B pathway was confirmed via a specific inhibitor, followed by evaluation of PAFR expression levels and S.aureus adhesion capacity. Results Clinically, serum TNF-a levels were significantly higher in IAV patients with bacterial co-infection. In the murine model, TNF-a KO markedly attenuated weight loss, lung tissue damage, and inflammatory responses. Transcriptomic analysis revealed a significant downregulation of PAFR expression in the lungs of TNF-a KO mice. Both in vivo and in vitro experiments consistently demonstrated that IAV infection or TNF-a stimulation upregulated PAFR expression in lung tissue and A549 cells via activation of the NF-?B pathway. This upregulation directly led to enhanced adhesion of S. Crucially, pharmacological inhibition of PAFR with WEB2086 effectively reduced bacterial adhesion, lowered lung bacterial burden, and mitigated pathological injury. Conclusion We defines a novel pathogenic mechanism in post-influenza bacterial co-infection: IAV infection triggers excessive TNF-a release, which activates the NF-?B pathway to upregulate PAFR expression on host cells, thereby significantly enhancing S. aureus adhesion and exacerbating disease severity. Our findings identify the TNF-a/NF-?B/PAFR axis as a critical mechanistic link and a promising therapeutic target for intervening in severe co-infection outcomes.

title: Simultaneous detection of influenza and SARS-CoV-2 on an AI-nanopore multiplex platform.
abstract: Seasonal influenza and SARS-CoV-2 co-circulate and present overlapping symptoms, creating demand for rapid multiplex diagnostics beyond the sensitivity limits of antigen tests and the infrastructure requirements of nucleic acid amplification tests. Here we report NanoMux, an amplification-free diagnostic platform that couples a solid-state nanopore with attention-based multiple-instance learning (Attention-MIL) to classify clinical saliva samples from their nanopore event streams. Each measurement is treated as a "bag" of unlabeled translocation events dominated by endogenous nanoparticles, while only a sparse subset contains virus like signatures. Attention-MIL learns to weight informative events during bag-level prediction, enabling robust classification in highly contaminated clinical matrices where conventional machine learning baselines degrade. In a three-class setting (SARS-CoV-2, influenza, and healthy controls), Attention-MIL achieved a macro F1 of 0.781, substantially outperforming a gradient-boosting baseline (0.327). Under diluted conditions, the LightGBM model exhibited a more gradual decline in accuracy than the Attention-MIL model, demonstrating greater robustness for low-concentration specimens. NanoMux establishes a physics-based, reagent-minimal route to rapid multiplex respiratory virus screening and provides a model framework for extracting sparse pathogen signals from noisy nanopore recordings.

title: A multi-epitope-based DNA vaccine confers cross-protection against influenza A H1N1 and H3N2 viruses
abstract: Background and Objectives: Influenza A virus remains a major global health concern because antigenic drift reduces the long-term efficacy of current vaccines. This study evaluated a multi-epitope DNA vaccine targeting conserved regions of hemagglutinin (HA) and polymerase acidic (PA) proteins from influenza A/H1N1 and A/H3N2 viruses. Materials and Methods: Conserved B-cell, CD4+ T-cell, and CD8+ T-cell epitopes were identified using immunoinformatic tools and linked to β-defensin-2 in the pcDNA3.1(+) vector. Protein expression was confirmed in HEK293 cells. BALB/c mice were immunized intramuscularly and challenged with lethal doses of H1N1 or H3N2 viruses. Humoral and cellular immune responses, lung viral loads, histopathology, and clinical outcomes were assessed. Results: Vaccinated mice exhibited undetectable or markedly reduced lung viral loads (1,000-10,000-fold; p<0.01), signifi- cantly decreased pulmonary lesions, and milder clinical manifestations than controls. Vaccination induced significant CD4+ (p=0.041) and CD8+ (p=0.038) T-cell responses in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid, accompanied by increased interferon-γ and interleukin-4 production, indicating balanced cellular and humoral immunity. Complete protection against mortality was observed following viral challenge. Conclusion: This multi-epitope DNA vaccine elicited cross-protective immunity against influenza A/H1N1 and A/H3N2 by targeting conserved HA and PA epitopes, supporting its potential as a candidate for universal influenza vaccine development.

title: Fed-batch production of antiviral OP7 chimera defective interfering influenza A particles
abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) defective interfering particles (DIPs) are regarded as promising broad-spectrum antivirals due to their high efficacy demonstrated in animal trials. Previously, an OP7 chimera DIP was generated that showed markedly enhanced antiviral efficacy compared to conventional IAV DIPs. In addition, a high-yield cell culture-based production process for OP7 chimera DIPs was established in perfusion mode. However, due to the technical complexity of this technology, we aimed to combine the advantages of perfusion in terms of yield with that of a simple and less complex batch process. In the present work, we established a fed-batch production process for OP7 chimera DIPs that allows a more straightforward implementation into existing production facilities. Using a feeding regime that was able to overcome the cell density effect, we achieved productive virus infection in stirred tank reactors until a cell density of 10E+6 cells/mL. Furthermore, we obtained a high virus titer of 3.8 log10(HAU/100 uL), corresponding to a 3.4-fold increase compared to a reference batch production. Moreover, the produced material demonstrated a significantly increased interfering bioactivity shown by an in vitro potency assay. Interestingly, this efficacy was similarly high as compared to OP7 chimera DIP material previously produced in perfusion mode, despite twofold lower virus titers. Finally, we demonstrate robustness of OP7 chimera DIP seed virus trains, which is significant step towards later pharmaceutical production. Further, corresponding GMP MDCK-PB2(sus) cell and OP7 chimera virus banks are now available for later biomanufacturing further use. In conclusion, the established fed-batch process offers a valid n additional option for pharmaceutical grade OP7 chimera DIP GMP manufacturing production under GMP conditions required for subsequent clinical testing and for later large-scale manufacturing.

title: Clinical characteristics and exploratory factors associated with in-hospital mortality in pediatric severe viral encephalitis
abstract: Objective The aim of this study was to describe the clinical characteristics of severe viral encephalitis (SVE) in children and to identify exploratory factors associated with in-hospital mortality, thereby providing preliminary evidence to facilitate early risk stratification and reduce SVE-related disability and mortality. Methods A retrospective study was conducted in 75 children diagnosed with viral encephalitis at the Department of Pediatrics, Anqing Municipal Hospital, from January 2023 to December 2025, including 50 mild cases and 25 SVE cases. Demographic data, clinical manifestations, and laboratory parameters (peripheral white blood cell count (WBC), serum sodium, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) leukocyte and protein levels, serum neuron-specific enolase (NSE), electroencephalography (EEG), neuroimaging findings, and Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) scores) were collected and compared between groups. Pathogen detection was conducted through multiplex PCR and/or serum viral IgM antibody testing. In the mild encephalitis group, 14 out of 50 cases (28%) were found to be infected with specific viruses, with enteroviruses (EVs) being the predominant type, accounting for 7 cases, followed by herpes zoster virus (VZV) and human herpesvirus type 6 (HHV-6), each with 2 cases. In the SVE group, 9 out of 25 cases (36%) were found to have pathogens, with influenza A virus (4 cases) and herpes simplex virus (2 cases) being the main ones. Univariate analyses and Firth-penalized logistic regression were used to explore factors associated with in-hospital mortality (primary outcome) within the SVE subgroup. Results Among the 25 children with SVE (15 males, mean age 7.74 ± 2.2 years), fever (76%), signs of elevated intracranial pressure (68%), and seizures (56%) were common; four patients died (16%). Compared with children with mild encephalitis, the SVE group exhibited significantly longer hospital stays, higher seizure rates, lower GCS scores, higher proportions of abnormal EEG and neuroimaging abnormalities, and elevated serum NSE (all P < 0.05). However, there were no significant differences in CSF leukocytes, CSF protein, blood leukocytes, or serum sodium. In univariate Firth-corrected logistic regression, neuroimaging abnormalities ( P = 0.007), seizures ( P = 0.011), EEG abnormalities ( P = 0.018), lower GCS score (per 1-point decrease, P < 0.001), and higher serum NSE (per 10 ng/mL increment, P = 0.018) were significantly associated with in-hospital mortality. Conclusion Pediatric SVE presents with nonspecific early symptoms and substantial mortality. Seizures, EEG and neuroimaging abnormalities, low GCS score, and elevated serum NSE are exploratory factors associated with in-hospital mortality. However, given the small sample size and single-center design, these findings are hypothesis-generating and require validation in larger multi-center prospective cohorts. Early recognition of these factors may aid in clinical risk assessment.

title: Swine Influenza A Virus Seropositivity in Greek Pig Farms: Sampling-Occasion and Age-Group Patterns, 2020–2022
abstract: Swine influenza A virus (swIAV) is a respiratory pathogen of pigs with zoonotic potential. This investigation evaluated overall and subtype-specific seropositivity in 2889 sera with available haemagglutination inhibition (HI) results from 94 sampling occasions on 64 Greek pig farms during 2020–2022. Antibodies against the H1avN1, H1huN2, H3N2 and H1pdmN1 subtypes were investigated, while age group, clinical signs potentially compatible with, but not specific to, swIAV infection, and sow vaccination status were recorded. title: Mathematical Modelling of the Spread of Avian Influenza (Bird flu) Using Reaction Diffusion Equation and Travelling Wave
abstract: Avian influenza remains a major threat to both wild and domestic bird populations, largely because its spatial spread through migratory movement is not fully understood. Developing accurate spatial models of transmission is essential for predicting outbreak patterns and guiding effective control strategies. To address this gap, this study constructs a reaction diffusion SIR model to describe how avian influenza spreads through a homogeneous bird population. The main objective is to understand the dynamics of disease invasion by determining the travelling-wave speed, finding the final proportion of susceptible birds after the outbreak, and analyzing the stability conditions under which the infection can either spread or die out. The model assumes that only infected birds move across space, while susceptible and recovered birds remain stationary. After formulating the system, the equations were nondimensionalized and transformed into ordinary differential equations using a travelling-wave approach. Linearization around the disease-free equilibrium yields a characteristic expression that determines the wave speed. The analysis shows that a travelling wave exists only when the speed satisfies c ≥ 2√(1 − 1 R0 ) The final number of susceptible birds is determined by the implicit relation(send) − 1 R0 ln(send) = 1 Stability analysis shows that the disease-free equilibrium is stable when 0 R 1. Overall, the results demonstrate that the movement of infected birds strongly influences both the speed and severity of epidemic spread. The model provides a useful theoretical framework for understanding spatial disease dynamics in migratory bird populations and offers insights that can support control measures such as quarantine, vaccination, and restrictions on bird movement.

title: Canadian News Media Coverage of Government-Mandated Depopulation Policies During Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza Outbreaks—A Sentiment Analysis
abstract: This study examines how Canadian news media portrayed government-mandated depopulation during Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) outbreaks and identified patterns in reporting tone and language. English-language Canadian news and magazine articles published between December 2021 and September 2025 were retrieved from ProQuest. Sentiment analysis was conducted separately for article titles and full text using SentiStrength and sentimentr, with a study-specific neutral word list applied. Term frequency–inverse document frequency (TF–IDF) analysis was used to identify distinctive terms in titles and body text, while temporal sentiment patterns were examined in relation to major HPAI outbreak developments and Canadian case counts. A total of 217 articles were included. Overall article body sentiment was near neutral (mean = −0.02) but showed negative shifts during periods of heightened outbreak activity and high-profile events. Title-level sentiment scores were more frequently classified as negative (45.6%) than positive (11.5%). Distinctive terms in reporting included outbreak-related, legal, and institutional terminology. The results suggest that media portrayals of HPAI depopulation varied over time alongside major outbreak developments and policy-related events. Monitoring news reporting may provide insight into communication surrounding animal disease control policies during outbreaks and may help inform communication planning by policymakers, industry organizations, and extension professionals.

title: MOLECULAR AND IMMUNE PROFILING OF INFLUENZA A/B INFECTION: ASSOCIATIONS BETWEEN VIRAL RNA BURDEN, ANTIVIRAL GENE EXPRESSION, AND SERUM CYTOKINES
abstract: The aim of the current study was to define molecular and immune responses among patients with influenza infection and examine the effect of viral load and antiviral and inflammatory markers. Eighty participants were involved in the research: 40 influenza patients and 40 healthy individuals. Results showed that 67.4% of influenza A and 32.6% of influenza B were present with a mean Ct/Cq value equal to 25.8 ± 3.4. Patients had higher average levels of the relative expression of IFNB1, MX1, and ISG15 genes (2.44 ± 1.05, 3.44 ± 1.29, and 3.61 ± 1.45, respectively) relative to healthy controls (1.00), showing significant differences (p<0.001). The levels of IL-6, TNF-α, IL-8/CXCL8, and IFN-γ were also higher in patients than in healthy controls (p<0.001). In conducting the Spearman correlation analysis, it became evident that all markers studied show a positive correlation with viral load, as evidenced by the ρ values ranging between +0.626 and +0.757 (p<0.001). The strongest correlation was observed with IL-8/CXCL8 and ISG15. The results indicate the joint activation of antiviral and inflammatory responses relating with viral load in patients with influenza.

title: Rare-Event Modelling of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza Presence for Poultry Biosecurity Surveillance in Delaware
abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) remains a major threat to poultry production and animal-health preparedness, but its rarity makes spatially consistent local surveillance prioritization difficult. This study developed a spatial rare-event modelling framework to transform sparse HPAI detections into 3-kilometre surveillance-priority scores in Delaware and evaluated adjacent-region transfer to Maryland. HPAI presence was modelled using poultry-house infrastructure, wetland and hydrographic proximity, agricultural land cover, topography, and wild-bird occurrence predictors. Model performance was assessed using spatial-block validation in Delaware and transfer to a separate Maryland grid. Elastic-net logistic regression achieved the highest Delaware area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) point estimate of 0.935 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.868–0.986), but discrimination was not statistically distinguishable from ridge logistic regression. The highest-ranked 5%, 10%, and 20% of Delaware cells contained 63.6% (95% CI: 30.8–89.1%), 81.8% (48.2–97.7%), and 90.9% (58.7–99.8%) of the 11 HPAI-positive cells, respectively. In Maryland, the Delaware-trained model achieved an AUC of 0.898 (95% CI: 0.719–0.984) and captured 64.3% (95% CI: 35.1–87.2%) and 85.7% (57.2–98.2%) of the 14 HPAI-positive cells in the highest-ranked 5% and 10%, respectively. Poultry infrastructure provided most of the discrimination (AUC = 0.930); adding environmental predictors increased AUC to 0.935, a difference not statistically distinguishable from zero. These findings support surveillance-priority screening for poultry biosecurity, outreach, and preventive action without attributing disease to individual farms.
